rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken word for an actual insect and can also label a contemptible or powerless person.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 cung4 sik1 fei1 wo3

rows.note: Use this more formal term when speaking precisely about the arthropod category; it is not normally used for the person metaphor.
